Sara Udon

III

A killer second suite of asymmetric dream architecture recorded in Osaka by Conrad Standish ov CS + Kreme with Koshiro Hino and Yuki Nakagawa ov KAKUHAN, mining a sweetspot between electroacoustic sorcery, drum machine ballistics and post rock poise, somewhere between Mark Fell, Tortoise, Autechre and Bill Laswell in their taut, jazzy unpredictability and embrace of negative space.

A Guy Called Gerald

Voodoo Ray EP

Gerald taking license to contrast the full, warehouse-resounding innovations and (2nd) summer of love optimism with rafter-scoping rimshots, wriggling 303, and swanging square bassline - plus that doubled-up and out of time lead hook. The best to ever do it.
